svg.title: NLP works through a stack of language layers
svg.desc: The NLP stack moves from tokenization through morphology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics, and discourse. The sentence “I saw a girl with a telescope” has two syntactic attachments: the speaker used the telescope or the girl had it.

g.text: NLP works through a stack of language layers
Ambiguity appears at multiple layers, from token boundaries to discourse context.
THE STACK · FROM FORM TO CONTEXT
3 Syntax · How do the words attach?
4 Semantics · What does it literally mean?
5 Pragmatics · What did the speaker intend?
One surface sentence, two valid parses.
